items.text: Giants WR Malik Nabers (knee) is officially active for SNF vs Cowboys after full practices and game-time decision. Decision was up to him post-ACL recovery.
items.why: Full participant all week; felt ready after warmups
items.implication: Start in all formats despite possible decoy/limitation risk
items.opportunity: High target share expected in return

items.text: Cardinals RB Jeremiyah Love (ankle) is ACTIVE. Risk/reward RB2 but start everywhere; team would not activate if major concern. Expected to play pregame reports confirmed.
items.why: Ankle sprain improving; expected per beat/Rapoport
items.implication: Start as RB2 with upside in debut/shared role
items.opportunity: Rookie carries and potential goal-line work

items.text: Weekend status: Jeremiyah Love and Rome Odunze expected to play; Alvin Kamara not expected; Josh Williams activated (Sean Tucker doubtful); Malik Nabers no news yet (later active). Kamara absence boosts Etienne projection.
items.why: Compiled beat and insider reports pre-inactives
items.implication: Core inactive window intel for main slate

items.text: Saints RB Alvin Kamara (knee/MCL sprain) is not expected to play and was confirmed inactive vs Lions. Full participant late week but not ready; game plan set for next week return.
items.why: MCL sprain from preseason; progressed but decision to hold
items.implication: Clears path for full workload backup

items.text: Combine ETR watch list with Brock Bowers (knee), AJ Brown (ankle), Sam Darnold (hip), others. Not a clean start for injuries Week 1.
items.why: Multiple early exits and known multi-week outs

items.text: Watching post-Sunday injuries: Zay Flowers (hamstring), Ladd McConkey (chest) left early; also Brian Thomas Jr (shoulder), Kyler Murray (concussion), others. Combined with prior Bowers/AJB wave.
items.implication: Monitor Monday reports for Week 2 availability; handcuffs/waivers

items.text: Starting Malik Nabers wherever rostered post-active confirmation. Risk/reward as possible decoy but must start.
items.why: Active after uncertainty; talent overrides decoy risk

items.text: Ravens rookie WR Ja'Kobi Lane ruled OUT (wrist); initial diagnosis fractured wrist, MRI tomorrow, out several weeks.
items.why: Wrist injury in game; fracture confirmed sources
items.implication: Ravens WR depth thins; Flowers/others elevated if healthy

items.text: Patriots WR A.J. Brown (high ankle sprain) will not need surgery but sidelined 4-6 weeks.
items.implication: Long-term stash; WR depth chart elevates

items.text: Bears WR Rome Odunze (calf) is officially active vs Panthers. Expected to play per morning reports.
items.implication: Full WR role available in Bears offense

items.text: Raiders TE Brock Bowers (knee/meniscus trim) OUT for Week 1. Realistic chance of only missing one game with Week 2 return possible vs Chargers; monitor midweek.
items.why: Meniscus surgery Tuesday; short recovery projected
items.implication: Sit Week 1; stash for potential quick return
items.opportunity: TE targets to Mayer or others short-term

items.text: Kamara's status (inactive) directly affects and elevates projection for Travis Etienne.
items.why: Absence removes committee; Etienne lead back

items.text: Main slate news locked. Nabers (Q knee) murky/up-to-him for SNF; Giants elevated Berrios and Cambre from PS. No major projection changes otherwise; projections live.
items.why: Status pending player decision; PS moves signal caution
items.implication: Hold flex options until final active; update projs on news

items.text: Isaiah Likely breakout season is well underway after strong performance.
items.opportunity: Targets with Andrews possibly sharing or injured context

items.text: Buy low on Colston Loveland. Preseason belief in Bears offense volume unchanged despite Week 1 quiet; want as much as possible.
items.why: Volume in Bears offense; early underperformance buy opportunity

items.text: Dontayvion Wicks role more real than not after preseason talk with new OC; production validates.
items.opportunity: Routes and targets in Mannion offense

items.text: Steelers CB Joey Porter Jr. officially inactive (back) amid contract dispute and trade possibility.
items.implication: Secondary impact for matchup; trade watch

items.text: Josh Williams activated; Sean Tucker doubtful (later inactive context). Impacts TB backfield with Irving/Gainwell.
items.why: Doubtful leading to inactive; Williams up
items.implication: Split or elevated work for Irving/Gainwell
